summary: Tenth Avenue kerb beside a cleared lot; homes across the road, cars park here.
reasons: Homes about 15-20 m across the road

best_section.where: Tenth Avenue north kerb, along the cleared lot between the two corners

drivers.seclusion: Bare cleared lot behind the kerb in Esri, a dwelling at the lot's far end; houses across the road sit roughly 15-20 m from the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parking lane; several cars park along this kerb, so a van fits.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential corner street between two junctions.
drivers.convention: Resident-permit 2P signs Mon-Fri 7am-6pm; overnight parking not restricted by these signs, and cars park here.

flags: Steep: about 9% grade (mean 9.3%, max 26.9% on one step)

sun_shade: Open to sky; no tree cover, houses shade the south side in the morning.
